definitions.full: H6537. prac מְּרֵס (read מְּרָס ? M 78* f. ) probably noun [masculine] half-mina (Late Hebrew מְּרָס , Old Aramaic פרש פרס, Lzb 354 SAC 99 Cooke 176, 406 ; see מְנֵא and references); — absolute ׳פ Dan 5:28 ; plural (וּ)פַרְסִין [read מְּרָסִין ? see M l.c .] 5:25 .
